description: This file defines wizard interfaces for numerating auction lots, including forms, data handling functions, and wizard state transitions.

classes.name: wiz_auc_lots_numerotate
classes.description: Wizard interface class for auction lot numeration, managing different states for user interaction.

methods.name: _read_record
methods.description: Reads auction lot record based on form input, raises error if not found.

methods.name: _test_exist
methods.description: Checks if auction lot exists based on form input, returns status string.

methods.name: _numerotate
methods.description: Updates the lot number for selected auction lots.

methods.name: _numerotate_cont
methods.description: Assigns a continuous number to multiple auction lots.
